_comment: The default stage sequence. A project overrides a stage by putting its own layers/L2-stages/stage-N.md in .agent-os/. deny/allow are matched against the project-relative path of the file being written; allow wins.

stages.name: SHAPE
stages.intent: Decide what the thing IS. Conversation, research, written options with tradeoffs, throwaway sketches. Nothing that assumes an answer.
stages.gate: Every open decision in the state file is answered in writing and the operator says the gate is met.
stages.why: Code written before the scope decision is the most expensive code in a project: it does not just get deleted, it quietly constrains the decision it preceded.

stages.name: DESIGN DIRECTION
stages.intent: Pick the direction by looking at real rendered options side by side, not by describing them. Several fundamentally different ones, each with its argument written down.
stages.gate: A named winner in the state file, what was salvaged from the losers, and the winning direction written down as a token system before any component consumes it.
stages.why: A design chosen from prose is a design chosen from training. The browser is the only honest judge.

stages.name: SYSTEM DESIGN
stages.intent: Write the software down before writing it: routes, data model, auth, third-party surfaces and their failure modes, deploy topology, environments, and what is out of scope for v1.
stages.gate: The plan file exists, the operator has read it, and the build is sliced into pieces that each fit one session and each have a verifiable exit.
stages.why: A multi-session build that lives in a context window is re-derived every session, differently each time.

stages.name: BUILD
stages.intent: Work the plan in order, one slice at a time, each slice ending in something that renders and is verified.
stages.gate: Every slice in the plan is closed, each verified when it landed rather than all at the end.

stages.name: HARDEN
stages.intent: Error paths, empty and loading states, 404 and 500, forms that fail well, accessibility, real metadata, performance on a slow connection, security headers, rate limits, and logging that reports a break before the operator finds it.
stages.gate: No mock data on a reachable path, no stub or TODO in a shipped path, no client-only validation, no secret in the bundle, and every feature observable in production.

stages.name: LAUNCH AND ITERATE
stages.intent: Deploy, verify against production rather than against the build, watch it, then iterate in slices.
stages.gate: Verified in production, and new work re-enters at the stage it needs rather than at BUILD because the repo already exists.
